limitations: All120 primary pairs retained; no outlier deletion or weighted formal-score extrapolation.
Most boundary groups have15 pairs; spill-filter and projection groups have3 pairs each.
Projection accounted timer sum includes ingest and7 phases, excludes other end-to-end wall time; no projection resource counters.
Other measured lifecycle excludes restart oracle wall; RSS/IO snapshots are proxies, not official cgroup M/B.
30k and60k regressions are not dismissed as noise; cause remains unresolved.
One standard restart pair had different fanout; sensitivity analysis retains a filtered-ANN negative result.
128d evidence is limited to the measured1024-row wide projection cases, not every dimension or workload.
Future PGO builds may differ in bytes; tests bind the stated image and binary.
Material validation is mechanical, not an official Prompt score or independent-authorship certification.
